lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: Then I'll sign it. God help me, I'll sign it, and I'll tell the others I got us through the winter, which will be true.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: A sensible house. Meridian will have surveyors up by Thursday and the wall staked out before the first frost.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: My order will be a tenant of Meridian for three hundred years and never once write that down in the charter. I grew up on that charter. I did not know.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: I am not angry with her. She has forty people and a well and no food. I would like to be angry with somebody and there is nobody in this yard to be angry with.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Vance closes her case without hurrying. Behind her, on the transport, something tall unfolds itself in sections and starts up the path.
